purpose: An already-decided semantic mutation request crossing the Core contract boundary; it is not permission, a lease, a platform payload, a journal record, or semantic reasoning.

semantic_model_facing_declared_inputs.description: Values that describe the requested semantic change and are bounded/validated by the operation descriptor.
examples: logical target reference supplied as a semantic choice

trusted_mechanical_resolved_context.description: Runtime-bound facts resolved after the intent crosses a trusted adapter boundary; ordinary model arguments cannot assert them.
trusted_mechanical_resolved_context.source: trusted adapter/runtime boundary and later mechanical resolution

model_boundary.trusted_metadata_transport: Adapters may carry trusted runtime metadata only through the trusted adapter boundary, not as ordinary model arguments.
model_boundary.typed_target_rule: A model-facing logical target is not trusted target identity until mechanically resolved to a typed ObjectRef and checked against the operation and authority evidence.

idempotency_key.kind: bounded caller identity for one semantic attempt

intent_fingerprint.kind: deterministic SHA-256 over canonical semantic intent

correlation_id.resolution: trusted runtime may honor a bounded supplied value; otherwise Core generates one

trusted_resolution_binding.principal: typed trusted Principal from TrustedContext; never from a plain model value
trusted_resolution_binding.typed_target: canonical ObjectRef resolved by the trusted/mechanical boundary
trusted_resolution_binding.subject_ref: owning Subject ObjectRef when the operation has Subject authority
trusted_resolution_binding.authority_source_revision: opaque external authority-store revision, distinct from Subject revision
trusted_resolution_binding.authority_observed_raw_digest: raw authority state observed before candidate construction
trusted_resolution_binding.normalized_plan_digest: semantic Portable Plan digest where applicable; never an external CAS token
trusted_resolution_binding.candidate_raw_digest: exact intended external document identity where applicable
trusted_resolution_binding.authorization_basis: trusted evidence reference resolved by M4-2; not created by intent
trusted_resolution_binding.capability_lease_or_reservation_referenc: opaque trusted reference resolved by M4-2; token bytes are excluded from the semantic fingerprint

intent_fingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted object keys, deterministic list order as declared by semantic schema, compact separators, and no derived fingerprint field
includes: semantic successor/predecessor choice when it is part of the request
excludes: platform comment identifier unless adapter-private target identity is genuinely semantic
intent_fingerprint.idempotency_rule: same idempotency identity plus same semantic intent fingerprint is replay-compatible; same identity plus different fingerprint is CONFLICT with no new requested effect

later_consumers: M4-2 trusted authorization and lease issuance
M4-5 mutation port and journal contract

semantic_choices: select one exact candidate and successor

EXAMPLE_D.name: same idempotency key / same intent replay

EXAMPLE_E.name: same idempotency key / different intent conflict
